Crappo Crypto Platform

Modern cryptocurrency investment platform featuring live market data, secure wallet connections, and sleek dark-mode UI components.

React REST API Chart.js Dark Mode UI
// the challenge

Business Challenge

This internal engineering project explored real-time data integration challenges common in fintech applications - specifically, rendering live cryptocurrency market data with responsive chart visualisations while maintaining sub-second UI responsiveness.

// our approach

Engineering Approach

Built as a single-page React application with Chart.js for real-time market visualisations. The architecture implemented efficient WebSocket-based data streams for live price updates, lazy-loaded component modules for performance, and a comprehensive dark-mode design system with accessible contrast ratios throughout.

Business Results & Metrics

  • Real-Time Data Rendering
    Live market data visualisation with sub-second updates demonstrating efficient WebSocket integration patterns.
  • Accessible Dark-Mode System
    Complete dark-mode design system meeting WCAG 2.1 AA contrast requirements across all interactive elements.
  • Component Architecture
    Modular React component library with documented props, enabling rapid prototyping of fintech-grade interfaces.
